Busyness is on the rise in connection with Black Friday and Christmas, and that's why we're looking for energetic employees for a packaging terminal in Taulov. You will be part of a team that takes pride in being punctual and delivering with precision. It's all about having fun while working.

What will you be doing?

At the packaging terminal in Taulov, it's all about sorting packages and ensuring they reach their correct destination throughout the country. The busyness increases during Black Friday and Christmas, and you will become a part of the team that:

• Unloads trucks

• Sorts packages and places them in bins

What do we require?

• The job does not require any special qualifications, but you should be in decent physical shape.

• Experience in physical activities and endurance is a clear advantage.

• There is lifting equipment for heavier packages.

When and where?

This is a part-time temporary position, and we need you from November 27th through December 19th. Shifts are available during the following hours:

• 12:00-16:00

• 16:00-20:00

• 20:00-24:00

• 00:00-04:00

Workdays are from Monday to Friday. For us, commitment and reliability are keywords, so we expect you to be ready to give your best every day. It's intense, but it's also enjoyable!

What do you earn?

Your hourly pay is 149,33 DKK, and you will also receive evening and night supplements after 6:00 PM.

Send your application and CV via the application button – we look forward to hearing from you.

If you are unsure whether this is the right opportunity for you, or if you have any questions and would like to learn more about the position, you are very welcome to contact Freja Lütken at freja.lutken@actief-hartmanns.dk or by phone at 41 21 14 57.

All enquiries will be treated confidentially. Actief Hartmanns A/S is managing the entire recruitment process on behalf of the company, so all communication should be directed to us. We encourage all qualified candidates to apply, regardless of age, gender, disability, ethnic background, religion, or nationality.

Interviews will be held on an ongoing basis, and we reserve the right to conclude the recruitment process once the right candidate has been found, before the application deadline.

**Responsibly 🌍🌱

**Responsibly is a VC-backed sustainability tech start-up with a vision of making every purchase in the world responsible. We're founded by serial entrepreneurs with previous successes like Ofload, Dixa and Neurons, funded by some of Europe's top VCs and angels, and now cash-flow positive with an incredibly exciting roadmap ahead.

**Let's change the world together 🎯

**More than 40% of global emissions, and really any ESG issue, are directly or indirectly impacted by procurement. Companies wield enormous purchasing power when they select and manage suppliers, so if we can put sustainability on every supplier scorecard out there, we really can change the world.

But it's hard: a company can have anywhere from 100 to 100,000 suppliers, analyzing each one's sustainability efforts is near-impossible, and most ESG ratings suck. Responsibly's AI-powered due diligence engine automates the due diligence on every supplier across every ESG data point, from risk and violations to positive actions, and turns it into insights that help companies build more sustainable supply chains.

**The engineering problem 🧩

**Most of what we do comes down to one hard thing: turning the world's messy, unstructured supplier data into something you can score.

A supplier's ESG reality is scattered across PDF sustainability reports, half-broken corporate websites, regulatory filings, news, and a dozen ERP exports that all name the same company differently. We scrape it, extract it, resolve the entities, normalise it, and put a number on it, at a scale where a single customer can have 100,000 suppliers.

That means real problems, not ticket-shaped ones. Extraction pipelines where the LLM is confidently wrong 5% of the time and you have to decide what to do about it. Entity resolution where "Nordic Steel A/S" and "NORDIC STEEL" and "Nordisk Stål" may or may not be the same company. Schema design for data that arrives in a different shape every time. If that sounds fun rather than exhausting, we should talk.

**Build next-gen products with next-gen technologies 🌟

**You'll work on a Next.js app leveraging the latest in server actions, server components and serverless architecture, building dynamic, high-performance applications with TypeScript, PostgreSQL and AI integrations.

We don't just leverage AI in our product; we're building a next-generation engineering team where you're not only encouraged but expected to adopt the latest technologies in how you work. Our engineers run agentic coding tools daily, and we'd rather talk about where they fall down than whether to use them.

**How We Work 🛠️

**

• The engineering team is small and you're reporting directly to Christian, our CTO. There is no layer between you and the decisions

• Specs are limited. You'll get a problem, what the output should look like, sometimes vaguely, and you're expected to own it from there to release; including where to ask for more information. If you'd rather have the approach agreed before you start, you will find this uncomfortable

• You choose how to solve it, and you ship it. Idea to production is days, not quarters. We run weekly sprints - considering going bi-weekly - most often with releases as the goal for the sprint. You own what you write across its whole lifecycle, including when it breaks

• There is little process versus a bigger organization, and what we're planning to adopt is mainly for the ai agents to support you

• You will sometimes be wrong, ship it, and fix it. That's okay

• We're in the office at Islands Brygge 3-5 days a week, on the water. We prefer meeting face-to-face to stay in sync and move fast, with some support for remote working

**What You'll Be Doing 🙌

**

• Take operational ownership of the code you write across the entire software development lifecycle

• Work on production code, from customer-facing features to bug fixing

• Design new features and see them through to completion

• Help build and evolve our services and infrastructure to stay ahead of our growth curve

• Turn conceptual ideas into production-ready, scalable features

• Be a big part of finding the best solutions to our daily challenges

**Requirements

**Where you lack a line on this list but can convince us you'll close the gap fast, apply anyway. We mean that literally: one of the best engineers we've had joined us as a junior and was senior within two and a half years.

**Three things we do need:

**

• A proven track record - or evidence of extraordinary ability. We care far more about what you've actually built than how many years you've been doing it. Senior engineers should have a track record of shipping and maintaining serious production software. But if you're earlier in your career and you've built something remarkable, we want to hear about it. We're looking for exceptional people, not arbitrary numbers on a CV

• Strong TypeScript, and the judgement that comes from shipping real software. You know the language deeply, but more importantly, you know what good production code looks like. You can make architectural tradeoffs, keep a codebase healthy as it grows, and tell the difference between an interesting technical problem and one that actually matters

• Strong database fundamentals, and an AI-native mindset. You understand PostgreSQL and relational data deeply — schema design, query performance, indexes, migrations, monitoring, and what happens when your database meets millions of messy real-world records. And AI isn't something you're interested in. It's already part of how you work. You use machines to build machines. You automate aggressively. You constantly look for ways to make yourself and the team 10× more effective. This is non-negotiable for us

**Nice to have, genuinely not required:

**

• Next.js specifically (Server Components, Server Actions, API routes). If you know modern React, you'll be fine within a fortnight

• Web scraping at genuinely awkward scale

• Working with large-scale data: data pipelines, analytics, transformations, or making sense of millions of messy records

• General ESG, procurement or supply-chain domain knowledge

**Benefits

****Practical stuff 📋

**

• Salary: band between 50-60k / month for a senior engineer

• ESOP: every full-time Responsibly'er owns a piece of the company. We'll show you the actual numbers, strike price, vesting, and what your slice could be worth at a few exit scenarios, before you have to decide anything

• Location: Copenhagen. You'll need to be here or firmly planning to move, and to have the right to work in Denmark. English is our working language

• Office: Islands Brygge, right on the water. Great lunch, great coffee, obligatory ping-pong table. Roughly three days a week together, flexible on which and on hours

**Also 🤩

**

• Enthusiastic, highly talented teammates from all backgrounds, always ready to share knowledge, support, and a beer

• Strong personal and professional development in a high-growth environment

• Annual company events and Friday bars

• Real impact. Life is about more than work

Job Description

Are you passionate about data and driven by the opportunity to make a real impact by helping companies turn facts into actionable insights? Do you thrive in dynamic environments, working with some of the most complex and modern data solutions on the market? Are you ready to take ownership of shaping data architecture? If so, you might be our next colleague.

In Data Management, you join a team that enables our customers to develop and manage their business based on data and knowledge.

As a Senior Data Architect, you will work in the intersection of technology and business. Data is at the core of everything we do, and our analyses, advice, and solutions consistently create real value for our customers. Your work involve developing technical solutions to collect, process, model, analyze, distribute, and visualize data.

To provide the best possible advice and support to our customers, we place great importance on staying up to date with the latest trends and technologies in data management. You will work with a broad range of market-leading technologies, including Fabric, Snowflake, Databricks, dbt, Microsoft SQL Server, Spark, Kafka, Dagster, Airflow, Terraform and others.

Responsibilites:

• 
Designing, modeling, and building data solutions such as data platforms, data warehouse architecture, and business intelligence applications.

• 
Taking co-ownership of data architecture, defining technical direction, and driving customer advisory, data strategy, and business analysis in collaboration with the project team and customer.

• 
Leading and mentoring team members, prioritizing and organizing work, and providing technical guidance and direction.

• 
Quickly getting up to speed on existing solutions and taking ownership of them, while defining the right path forward for new projects based on best practices.

• 
Performing technical quality assurance and reviews on data models, ETL processes, and solution architecture across projects.

About you

You hold a relevant degree in data science, software engineering, computer science, mathematical modelling, or a similar field, along with solid professional experience in data management. Through your professional experience, you have gained deep technical expertise and a structured, logical approach to solving complex data challenges. As a Senior Data Architect, you are comfortable stepping into a leadership role guiding both people and the technical direction, and you thrive in a collaborative, development-oriented environment with a focus on continuous learning.

To succeed in this role, you have significant experience with:

• 
Designing and implementing data solutions, including data modelling, ETL/ELT, and data warehousing.

• 
Multiple languages and technologies such as various versions of SQL, Python, and R, as well as Fabric, Snowflake, dbt, Microsoft SQL Server, Databricks, Dagster, Terraform and others.

• 
Business Intelligence tools such as Power BI, Tableau, or similar.

• 
Supporting customers and colleagues through professional expertise and guidance.

• 
Full professional proficiency in Danish and English (written and spoken) is a must.

Continue developing with us

At Netcompany, we focus on your personal and professional development.

When you join us, you will be assigned a personal mentor who will guide you through your development and help you achieve your goals. The close relationship with an experienced colleague helps ensure the well-being of each employee and provides you with concrete insights into the many different career opportunities as you build your experience.

Additionally, you will be enrolled in our internal training programme, Netcompany Academy, where you are offered courses and seminars on everything from technologies to customer management. All courses are taught by experienced Netcompany colleagues, ensuring that all content is highly relevant and builds upon your professional skills, preparing you for various tasks and continuously improving your expertise throughout your career with us.

Join an inclusive community

At Netcompany, we highly prioritise an inclusive community. We actively promote an open and welcoming work culture based on collaboration and mutual trust, where there is always an opportunity for sparring.

As part of our culture and values, all employees, regardless of background, identity, and experience, are met with understanding and respect and given equal opportunities for development and well-being.

As we are an international company with offices in many countries, you will have the opportunity to learn and collaborate internationally with colleagues from across the world. We offer a shared environment where we engage with each other across departments and projects. Additionally, we have a wide range of social and professional events that provide you with the best opportunities to expand and build a network early in your career.

Send us your application

Upload your resume and a motivational letter to our recruitment system via the link. If you have unanswered questions, feel free to write to hr.dk@netcompany.com.

All qualified candidates are encouraged to apply regardless of gender, gender expression, sexuality, disability, age, religion and belief, political views, nationality, ethnicity, or social background.

We are committed to creating an inclusive and diverse environment. Our recruitment processes are based on individual merit. If you require any reasonable adjustments or additional support during the interview process, please email our recruiters at reasonableadjustments@netcompany.com for assistance. #LI-SA1

_Turn financial insight into measurable business impact

_Do you know how to turn financial data into clear commercial decisions — and want to see your insight make a real difference? Join Group Finance at the heart of an ambitious international business. As Group Business Controller, with primary focus on the UK, you will help strengthen performance, sharpen decision-making and build reporting that scales with the business.

Location: Copenhagen, Denmark, with limited travel to the UK as required.

**The opportunity

**Based at our Group office in Copenhagen and reporting to the Group Finance Manager, you will combine Group-wide contribution with hands-on ownership of the UK business. As the link between Group Finance, UK Operations and store teams, you will create consistency in reporting, strengthen performance management and translate data into actionable business insight. You will also help modernise how we work with data by advancing report automation, dashboards and the practical use of AI — delivering faster, more reliable insight.

**Your Key Responsibilities

**

• Own UK performance: Act as Group Finance business partner for UK Operations and take primary ownership of the UK P&L

• Lead performance reviews: Drive UK monthly reporting and variance analysis in line with Group standards and timelines.

• Shape plans and decisions: Lead UK budgets and forecasts, contribute to Group planning processes and support commercial business cases.

• Keep performance on track: Support month-end closing and identify risks, opportunities and corrective actions.

• Modernise reporting: Improve financial models, dashboards and reporting, with a clear focus on automation, scalable processes and the practical use of AI where relevant.

**To succeed in this role, you bring

**

• Strong financial toolkit: Proven skills in budgeting, forecasting, P&L analysis and management reporting.

• Commercial perspective: An analytical mindset and the confidence to challenge assumptions and influence stakeholders.

• Data and systems expertise: Advanced Excel skills, strong experience with ERP systems and knowledge of Business Intelligence tools such as Power BI. Curiosity and practical experience with report automation, data tools and AI-supported ways of working are a strong advantage.

• Relevant background: A finance or business degree, combined with solid experience in business controlling, FP&A or finance business partnering.

• Fluency in English and Danish is a requirement for this role.

**What We Offer

**

• Meaningful ownership: Take responsibility for financial performance in a key international market.

• International collaboration: Work closely with leaders and Finance teams in Denmark and the UK.

• Room to improve: Shape reporting, processes and decision support in a varied, influential role.

As part of the Lagkagehuset family, we offer opportunities for development and skill-building, allowing you to actively contribute to our growth journey. We provide a salary package based on your experience, including a pension scheme, health insurance, and, of course, discounts on our products in all Lagkagehuset stores.

**Ready to make an impact?

**Ready to combine financial ownership with close business collaboration — and make your insight count? Submit your CV and application through our recruitment portal. We review applications on an ongoing basis. If you have any questions regarding the position you can contact Group Finance Manager, Helle Høyrup Nielsen on hen@lagkagehuset.dk

**Are you passionate about technology products and ensuring they deliver real business value? Then we might have just the job for you at Specsavers.

**_Join Specsavers as our new Technology Product Owner in our Audiology Product Team and play a key role in shaping the vision, roadmap, and delivery of technology products that support our hearing care colleagues, customers, and business across Northern Europe.

_**Your role

**As our Technology Product Owner within the Audiology Product Team, you will be responsible for managing, developing, and continuously improving products that support our audiology business and create value for colleagues and customers across Northern Europe.

You will report into the Technology Product Manager and own the roadmap, backlog, and release planning, working closely with agile teams, (business analysts, architects, product specialists, business stakeholders, and external partners). Acting as the voice of the product, you will balance strategic priorities, stakeholder needs, and user insights to drive meaningful product outcomes. You are a strong communicator and collaborator who thrives in complex environments, brings people together around a shared vision, and inspires confidence in your product decisions.

**Key Responsibilities Include

**

• Own the roadmap, backlog, and release planning.

• The Product Owner is responsible for delivering what brings the most value to the organization from their product.

• Collaborate with agile teams, stakeholders and vendors to deliver valuable and impactful product outcomes.

• Build strong stakeholder relationships and ensure alignment through clear and transparent communication.

• Gather feedback, and continuously improve the product based on user and business needs.

• Balance business requirements, user needs, and technical considerations to achieve the best outcomes.

• Manage the product throughout its lifecycle, from idea and development to retirement.

**Your new team

**You'll join our newly established Audiology Product Team within the Northern Europe Technology function and work closely with Product Managers, agile development teams, architects, business stakeholders and external vendors.

As part of a collaborative and international environment, you'll help ensure our products meet customer needs while supporting business goals and strategic priorities. Together, we focus on delivering solutions that create lasting value for our colleagues, customers, and business.

Our Audiology platform supports our instore customer journey and consists of:

• Patient Management system incl. Clinical Journal.

• Integration services.

• Clinical Devices for capture of Hearing test measurements and examinations

**What are we looking for?

**We are preferably looking for a candidate with the following competencies:

• Experience owning and developing technology products in complex business environments.

• Strong stakeholder management, communication, and influencing skills.

• Deep understanding of agile product development and value-driven prioritisation.

• Ability to navigate complexity, balance competing priorities, and make sound product decisions.

• Strong business acumen with a focus on delivering customer and business value.

**It Would Be An Advantage If You Have

**

• Experience in Product Management or Product Ownership, ideally supported by a certification such as PSPO or CSPO.

• Experience working across multiple business functions, countries, or distributed teams.

• Experience with facilitation and discovery methods

• Knowledge of retail, healthcare, optometry, audiology, or other customer-focused environments.

**As a Person, We Believe That You Are

**

• Proactive and self-driven

• A strong communicator who builds trust and creates alignment across teams and stakeholders.

• Curious and eager to learn, challenge assumptions, and identify opportunities for improvement.

• Structured and pragmatic in your approach and collaboration.

• Inspirering through influence rather than authority.

**What Awaits You Upon Joining Specsavers

**At Specsavers, you'll get more than just a job. You will join us on a journey to make eye health and hearing services accessible to everyone.

We offer an exciting and challenging role in an organisation with strong ambitions, where you'll be part of a collaborative and supportive culture.

**Joining Us, You’ll Get

**

• Competitive compensation and benefits.

• Opportunities for professional and personal development.

• A collaborative and inclusive workplace.

• The opportunity to influence technology products used across multiple countries and markets.

• The chance to work with talented colleagues in an international environment.

• A meaningful role where your decisions have a direct impact on business outcomes and customer experiences.

**Is this your next step? Then apply today

**To apply, please send us your CV using the button below. We want to respect your time, so including an application letter is optional. Feel free to apply as soon as possible. Please avoid including any photos or references to your age in your CV. It contributes to a fairer and more unbiased assessment.

We review CVs and invite candidates for interviews on an ongoing basis. Our recruitment process typically consists of an initial screening, two rounds of interviews, and a personality assessment feedback session.

If you have any questions regarding the role, please contact the hiring manager Lea Lie Kirk Holdensen by e-mail: lea.holdensen@specsavers.com.

**Diversity & Inclusion at Specsavers

**Specsavers will consider all qualified applicants for employment without regard to race, colour, religion, sex, age, national origin, disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity, or any other legally protected factor.

In line with our commitment to diversity, equity, and inclusion, we integrate these principles into all aspects of our work, from product development to team building.

**The Impact You'll Make

**Do you enjoy turning complex technical data into insights that drive better products and smarter decisions? Are you passionate about combining data science with engineering and domain expertise to solve real-world challenges? Then this could be the opportunity for you.

As our Lead Engineer, Data Science, you’ll play a key role in transforming product, sensor and operational data into meaningful insights that support innovation, energy efficiency and data-driven decision-making across Danfoss Climate Solutions.

Working closely with business teams, engineers and data platform specialists, you’ll combine strong analytical capabilities with engineering and domain knowledge to identify high-value opportunities, shape AI and analytics use cases and help build a robust, AI-ready data foundation for future intelligent solutions.

**What You’ll Be Doing

**

• Translate complex business and engineering challenges into analytical questions, data-driven models and actionable insights

• Analyze product, sensor, device and operational data to identify patterns, trends and opportunities for performance and energy optimization

• Apply engineering and domain knowledge to shape high-value data science and AI use cases, including feature definition, hypothesis development and validation strategies

• Collaborate with data engineers and platform teams to improve data quality, accessibility and usability across analytics and data products

• Contribute to semantic models and knowledge graph capabilities that capture relationships between sensors, devices, assets and their operational context

• Communicate insights and recommendations clearly to technical and business stakeholders, helping turn analytical findings into practical business actions

**What We're Looking For

**

• Strong foundation in thermodynamics and physics, with the ability to apply first-principles reasoning to heating and cooling systems and processes

• Experience in data science, applied analytics or similar roles within a technical, industrial or engineering environment

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with proficiency in Python and SQL and the ability to translate engineering insight into data-driven models

• Good understanding of modern data and ML environments, including cloud platforms and the machine learning lifecycle

• Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively across engineering, data and business teams

• Experience with HVAC, refrigeration, heating/cooling, energy systems or industrial operational data is considered a strong advantage

**What You'll Get From Us

**

• We promote from within and support your learning with mentoring, training, and access to global opportunities.

• You’ll have flexibility, autonomy, and support to do your best work while maintaining a healthy work-life balance. Your well-being matters to us.

• We strive to create an inclusive work environment where people of all backgrounds are respected, and valued for who they are.

• You’ll receive benefits like 13th salary, annual bonus, paid vacation, pension plans, personal insurance, and more. These vary by country and contract, but they’re worth asking about—we think they’re pretty great.

**Ready to Make a Difference?

**If this role excites you, we’d love to hear from you! Apply now to start the conversation and learn more about where your career can go with us.

**Our Commitment to Transparency

**Salary ranges listed reflect only primary location and currency. For local salary ranges and specific benefits in your preferred hiring location, please ask your Talent Acquisition representative for more information.

The actual salary offer will carefully consider a wide range of factors, including your skills, qualifications, experience, and location. Any benefits listed do not promise or guarantee any particular benefit or specific action. They may depend on country or contract specifics and are subject to change at any time without prior notice.

Want to know more? Please visit our **FAQ Page.

**All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or other protected category.

• Full-time

Job Description

Do you want to turn cybersecurity challenges into practical automation that makes security operations faster and more consistent? As our IT Security Specialist – Automation, you will take ownership of developing our security automation capabilities and help shape how we work with SOAR at JYSK.

You will join JYSK Head Office in Aarhus and work closely with colleagues across our security team. This is an opportunity to combine cybersecurity, automation and hands-on problem-solving in a role where you can take an idea from identifying an opportunity to implementing a working solution.

WHAT WE OFFER YOU

As an IT Security Engineer, you will become part of a collaborative team that works with modern tools and methods to improve JYSK’s security posture. You will also benefit from a strong focus on your personal and professional development through structured learning and collaboration with colleagues across IT and the wider business.

Furthermore, we offer you:

• A young, dynamic team dedicated to IT security and cyber defence

• A healthy work-life-balance supported by a flexible work-from-home policy

• Opportunities to work on passion projects alongside your core responsibilities

• A relaxed, open-minded working environment with collaboration opportunities across all levels of the organisation

• Attractive staff benefits and discounts within the Lars Larsen Group

• Freshly prepared breakfast and lunch served daily by our canteen

• Tailored training and courses to support your development and career path

WHAT YOUR NEXT JOB WILL BE ABOUT

You will take ownership of the implementation, development and day-to-day operation of our security automation platform, from initial setup to continuous improvement. Working closely with the security team, you will identify opportunities for automation, understand operational needs and turn them into practical and reliable security workflows.

A key part of your role will be driving our SOAR journey forward. You will have room to take initiative, challenge existing ways of working and identify where automation can reduce manual effort and improve the consistency of our security operations.

Your tasks and responsibilities in the job include:

• Design, build, test and maintain SOAR playbooks and automated response workflows for security incidents and operational processes

• Improve and streamline incident response processes to reduce manual work and enable faster, more consistent responses

• Integrate the SOAR platform with security tools and data sources, including SIEM, EDR, identity, threat intelligence and ticketing systems

• Monitor, troubleshoot and continuously improve existing security automations to keep them reliable, maintainable and fit for purpose

• Work with the security team to identify automation opportunities and translate operational requirements into effective workflows

• Drive security automation initiatives from idea to implementation and proactively identify what should be automated next

You can read more about our department here.

WHAT SHOULD YOU BRING

You may already have experience from cybersecurity, security operations or incident response and now want to specialise further in security automation. More important is your ability to take ownership, learn quickly and turn technical challenges into solutions that work in practice.

We are looking for a new colleague who:

• Has 3+ years of experience in cybersecurity, preferably within security operations, incident response, SIEM or security automation

• Takes ownership and works independently, with the ability to move a challenge forward without needing every step defined

• Has a practical and curious approach to understanding how systems and processes work and translating requirements into solutions

• Has experience with, or a strong interest in, SOAR platforms, security automation, scripting and system integrations

• Has experience with Python or a similar scripting language, or is motivated to develop these skills further

• Communicates clearly with both technical and non-technical colleagues and is comfortable driving initiatives across a security team

• Takes initiative, learns quickly and is motivated by building new solutions and improving existing ways of working

Additional Information

IS THIS YOUR NEXT OPPORTUNITY? Apply today!

If you have any questions regarding the position, please contact CISO, Rasmus Veidiksen at +45 2835 5369.

_Are you an experienced leader with a strong track record in offshore wind operations, service delivery, or project execution? Do you thrive in dynamic environments where safety, customer focus, and operational excellence go hand in hand? Then we look forward to your application as Area Manager (f/m/d) for Main Component Exchanges!

**Your position

**In your new position as Area Manager (f/m/d) for the Main Component Exchanges, you will lead the regional delivery of our offshore MCE business across Northern & Central Europe or the UK. You will be accountable for regional performance and play a key role in ensuring the successful execution of complex offshore campaigns. The position is based on the responsibilities defined in the MCE operating model.

The position is full-time, and you can expect to travel regularly depending on your main place of work. The projects are typically short- and long-term service contracts for our clients in Northern and Central Europe as well as the UK.

**Your Tasks & Responsibilities

**As Area Manager (f/m/d), you will be responsible for the overall performance of your region and ensure that customer commitments are delivered safely, efficiently, and predictably. You will provide leadership across Project Management, Operational Management, and Marine Operations while maintaining strong relationships with customers and key stakeholders. The role combines strategic oversight with operational leadership and serves as the primary escalation point within the region.

**Your Tasks Will Include But Are Not Limited To

**

• Leading regional project and operational delivery performance

• Ensuring successful delivery of customer commitments regarding safety, quality, schedule, and cost

• Prioritizing resources and resolving cross-project conflicts

• Managing customer, operational, and project escalations

• Supporting strategic workload and capability planning

• Driving collaboration across Project Management, Operational Management, and Marine Operations

• Ensuring implementation of the MCE operating model across the region

• Supporting Sales & Business Development through customer, market and operational expertise

**Your Profile & Qualifications

**We are looking for an experienced and communicative Area Manager (f/m/d) who is passionate about Main Component Exchanges within Offshore Wind and wants to take ownership. You have a proactive and organised approach to your work.

To succeed in this position, we imagine that you have:

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Engineering, Business, Project Management, or a related discipline

• Proven leadership experience in offshore wind, marine operations, energy services, or a comparable industry

• Strong understanding of project delivery, operations, and customer management

• Experience managing multidisciplinary teams and stakeholders

• Excellent communication and decision-making skills

• A strong HSEQ mindset and commitment to safe execution

• Fluency in English, both written and spoken

**Welcome to Semco Maritime

**At Semco Maritime, we create change. For people. For projects. And for the global energy sector. With us, you will join a community of over 2,300 of the most dedicated thinkers and doers in the energy industry who are driving real change and making their own personal mark on the global energy landscape.

While everyone knows why the energy transition is vital, we are concerned with the journey. How to get there. By providing the answers needed to make change real. Because we believe that global energy ambitions can only be realized through hard work and clever pragmatic solutions. This is what we do. This is what we invite you to participate in.

jobs.description:
Combine weather modelling, machine learning and Python to turn complex data into actionable insights and production-ready solutions that support trading decisions across various power markets.

The job

Here’s what the job entails

In the role, you will work at the intersection of weather data modelling and fundamental forecasting, driving research and innovation within quantitative weather analysis.

More specifically, your responsibilities include:

• 
conducting research in AI- and data-driven weather modelling within a power trading context

• 
developing and improving fundamental forecasting solutions that translate weather signals into actionable power market insights

• 
performing ad hoc weather and market analyses to support trading, renewable asset balancing and commercial decision-making

• 
exploring new data sources, modelling approaches and analytical methods to strengthen our quantitative weather capabilities

• 
turning research and analysis into robust, scalable solutions that can be used directly by traders and algorithms

The team

Meet the team

You will join our Quantitative Weather Analysis team, where we develop weather-driven insights, forecasts and models that support trading decisions and renewable asset optimisation across our business.

We are a team of specialists with backgrounds in data science, physics and computational biophysics. We take our work seriously, but not ourselves, and aim to create an informal atmosphere and a team where people genuinely enjoy working together. We also value spending time with each other beyond the task at hand, whether that is grabbing a coffee, having lunch or simply catching up during the day. Together, we have built a culture where we help each other, share knowledge freely and feel comfortable asking questions or challenging ideas.

By combining multidimensional weather data, machine learning and market understanding, you’ll help shape trading decisions and optimise the balancing of our renewable asset portfolio.

Talia Zeppelin

Head of Quantitative Weather Analysis

Your qualifications

But enough about us… over to you!

As you will be working deeply with quantitative modelling and large datasets, we imagine that you take a curious and proactive approach to your tasks. You enjoy digging into how things work with a research-to-action mindset and challenge existing approaches when you see room for improvement. We also expect that you are comfortable taking ownership of projects while collaborating with stakeholders across the organisation.

Furthermore, we imagine that you:

• 
have an educational background in Economics, Physics, Computer Science, Mathematics, Data Science or a related quantitative field

• 
are experienced in writing production-quality, maintainable code in Python

• 
are comfortable working in Linux-based environments and using common command-line tools

• 
have a solid quantitative foundation and can work with statistical, mathematical or data-driven modelling

• 
can work with large, complex datasets and transform data-driven insights into practical solutions

• 
are curious about the power trading domain and has an execution and collaborative mindset

Please note that prior knowledge of the energy sector is not required for this role.

jobs.occupation: Product Manager – Notifications | Help Dalux Users Focus on What Matters
jobs.description:
**Product Management at Dalux – Turning Information into Attention

**Construction projects generate an enormous amount of information. Files change. Tasks are assigned. Deadlines approach. Comments are added. Reviews require action. Issues are reported. People are mentioned. Workflows progress. But more information does not necessarily make people better informed.

Dalux is looking for a Product Manager to take dedicated ownership of Notifications and help us answer a deceptively difficult product question:

**How do we make sure users know what requires their attention – without overwhelming them with information?

**Notifications exist throughout our products today, across email, mobile, and in-product experiences. As Dalux has grown, so has their complexity. We believe this area deserves dedicated product ownership and a coherent strategy across our products.

**Your responsibilities will include:

**

• Notification Strategy: Define a coherent product direction for how Dalux communicates important events and required actions to users.

• Product Discovery: Understand when users need to be informed, when they need to take action, and when a notification simply creates unnecessary noise.

• Customer Insights: Research how different users manage information and attention across complex projects and busy working days.

• Cross-product Ownership: Map and improve notification experiences across Dalux products rather than optimizing individual notifications in isolation.

• Channels & Preferences: Develop experiences spanning in-app notifications, email, mobile push, notification preferences, subscriptions, following, mentions, reminders, and digests.

• Relevance & Prioritization: Explore grouping, prioritization, timing, and deduplication to ensure important information stands out.

• Actionability: Make notifications useful by ensuring users understand why they received them, what has changed, and what action they should take.

• Product Analytics: Use quantitative and qualitative insights to understand which notifications create value and which create noise.

• Shared Capabilities: Work with Development and other Product Managers to create common notification principles and platform capabilities that can be reused across Dalux.

**About You

**You probably don't currently have "Notifications Product Manager" as your job title – and that's perfectly fine.

We're looking for an experienced Product Manager who finds the underlying problem interesting and has the product and systems thinking required to solve it.

We believe you:

• Have strong Product Management experience, preferably from B2B SaaS, collaboration, productivity, workflow, communication, or similar software.

• Have excellent product discovery and UX instincts.

• Think systematically and can turn many individual use cases into coherent product concepts.

• Understand the tension between keeping users informed and creating notification fatigue.

• Are comfortable owning a horizontal capability spanning multiple products and development teams.

• Can combine user research with product analytics to understand behavior.

• Care about interaction details and understand how seemingly small product decisions can have a large cumulative impact on user experience.

• Can simplify complex systems involving events, recipients, relevance, timing, preferences, and communication channels.

• Communicate fluently in English, written and spoken.

**Construction Technology Experience Is Welcome But Not Required .

**Experience from collaboration, communication, workflow, or productivity software would be particularly relevant.

**What To Expect At Dalux

**At Dalux, you'll join a product-driven company where ideas quickly become reality and where you'll have a direct impact on the products we build.

We offer:

• A collaborative and informal work environment with flat hierarchies

• High ownership, trust, and the freedom to drive initiatives

• Talented and dedicated colleagues in an international team

• A central Copenhagen office, flexible work hours, and no dress code

• Monthly social events and an active community

• Attractive benefits including health insurance, lunch, fitness facilities, and free parking

• Opportunities for professional growth and development

**Ready for the next step?

**We are reviewing applications on an ongoing basis, so please submit your resume and application as soon as possible.

**About Dalux

**Founded in 2005, Dalux is a Danish Contech company revolutionizing the construction industry with innovative software built on geometric processing and 3D computer graphics.

Over the past years, we’ve grown by 40% annually and now have over 900 employees across 50+ offices in more than 25 countries. All product development takes place in our Østerbro, Copenhagen office, where we focus on building the future of construction technology. We place great value on our strong social community and close collaboration with colleagues, which is why we primarily work from our Copenhagen location.

**Application deadline:

**As soon as possible

**💰 🇩🇰 up to 75,000 DKK gross/month (depending on seniority level)

****About The Role

**We are looking for an experienced financial-crime leader to be our registered MLRO / Hvidvaskansvarlig (HVL

• 7, stk. 2) for Monta Pay ApS under our EMI license and to lead Financial Crime Prevention (FCP) across Monta, group-wide for the Danish/EEA EMI plus UK and US compliance as those markets scale. The role is registered with Finanstilsynet, so the appointment is subject to a fit & proper assessment as a change of key function holder.

Monta Pay ApS holds an Electronic Money Institution (EMI) license, granted by Finanstilsynet in April 2026. We are now migrating our financial services from Monta ApS to Monta Pay ApS, with go-live planned for Q2 2027. This is the moment the AML/FCP framework moves from build to live operation, and you will own it.

This is a high-profile, senior role. You sit at the centre of our financial-services compliance strategy as we scale, "directly exposed to the fire." You must balance obligations against resources with a risk-based approach, communicate complex issues clearly to senior leaders and the Board, and run your work-streams with strong, solution-oriented project management. In return, you have an outsized impact on how Monta builds and operates financial services compliance, and direct exposure to decision-making at a fast-growing scale-up.

You report day to day to Nick Skovsen, COO of Monta Pay ApS, with direct, independent access to the CEO and executive management of Monta Pay ApS and to its Board and Governance, Risk & Compliance Committee.

**Key Responsibilities

**

• Registered MLRO / Hvidvaskansvarlig: Act as the statutory AML-responsible person for Monta Pay under the EMI license. Approve AML/CTF policies and high-risk customer relationships escalated by the first line (PEPs, and business involving high-risk third countries). Receive internal escalations, decide on and file SARs/STRs with the FIU, and be the primary AML contact for Finanstilsynet.

• Own the Financial Crime Prevention framework: Steward Monta's FCP model (our nine-pillar "FC9" framework) covering AML/CFT, sanctions, fraud, and anti-bribery & corruption. Propose the risk appetite and risk-based approach for Board approval and monitor against it, and keep the framework effective and proportionate to our activities, customer types (B2B & B2C), and transaction flows.

• Fraud, transaction monitoring & customer due diligence: Own the frameworks for fraud prevention, transaction monitoring, and KYC/KYB (CDD/EDD, PEP and sanctions screening) across onboarding and the lifecycle (EU and US). Set the rules, thresholds and procedures the Financial Operations team runs in the first line, and assure their quality and effectiveness.

• Sanctions & screening: Set the screening standards (lists, thresholds, re-screening frequency) and assure the quality of first-line alert handling.

• Policy suite, risk assessment & governance: Maintain the AML/CFT policy suite in the Centralised Policy Register (with version control and Board-approval tracking), and own the Business-Wide Risk Assessment (BWRA) and the AML risk assessment underpinning the framework.

• Regulatory reporting: Deliver AML and payments regulatory reporting (for example Section 99 Payment Act, KPSD, AML/CTF returns) and ensure CESOP readiness.

• Technology, controls & assurance: Work with Product and Engineering on case management, screening and monitoring tooling and AI/automation, oversee AML-relevant third parties, and run the internal-controls framework (monitoring, QA, remediation).

• Training, culture & Board liaison: Build AML/FCP training and a strong compliance culture, and advise Senior Management and the Board GRC Committee on financial-crime risk, regulatory change, and performance.

• Build and lead the team: Build out and lead the second-line FCP/AML team as volumes grow post go-live.

What You’ll Walk Into (first 6 to 12 months)

• The foundations are in place; the job is to make them operational for go-live.

• On AML: everything required to obtain the EMI license has been submitted and approved. The remaining gap is operational readiness, and that is the focus: embedding the framework in day-to-day operations and rolling it out with our customers and with colleagues across Monta.

• On FCP: This role brings centralised ownership and direction, consolidating what already exists, formalising it into clear Standard Operating Procedures, and training the relevant teams on them ahead of go-live.

• Concrete early priorities include standing up transaction monitoring and fraud detection, locking v1.0 of the policy suite (Sanctions, PEP, EDD, Outsourcing, and the Sanction-Screening and SAR/STR filing SOPs) into the Centralised Policy Register, building the regulatory-reporting data structure and CESOP readiness, finalising KYC/KYB (EU + US), and securing your Finanstilsynet fit & proper approval ahead of go-live. A structured focus-areas plan accompanies this role.

**Requirements

**

• Minimum 3 years (ideally 5+, given this is a registered key-function role) of relevant experience in the prevention of money laundering and terrorist financing, ideally in a licensed EMI, payment institution, bank, or regulated fintech. Comparable experience in public authorities, AML consulting, or other AML-regulated sectors (for example gaming/gambling) will also be considered.

• Strong, current understanding of Danish AML law (Hvidvaskloven) and the EU framework (AMLD/AMLR, EBA guidelines), plus sanctions regimes. Awareness of the incoming EU AML package (AMLR + AMLD6, applying July 2027) is a plus.

• Eligibility to pass a Finanstilsynet fit & proper assessment. Prior approval in a fit & proper / key-function role at an EU financial institution is a strong advantage.

• Hands-on experience with fraud prevention and transaction monitoring, and with the underlying tooling (KYC/KYB, screening, monitoring, case management). Data literacy and comfort with AI/automation are a plus.

• Experience across risk controls, compliance, the payments area, credit management, or lines-of-defence leadership. Fintech/scale-up experience is a plus.

• Strong communication skills, autonomy, and sound decision-making, with the ability to build from a blank page and then scale a function and team.

• Analytical and investigative skills to detect patterns and anomalies in financial transactions and to investigate suspicious activity.

• Danish speaking, or willing to learn (the role is regulator-facing).

• Relevant education (economics, mathematics, law, or financial-sector training) is a plus.

• No prior convictions or legal issues that would make the candidate unfit for the role, particularly offences related to financial crime, fraud, money laundering, or other criminal activities undermining trust and integrity.

_If this sounds like you, we look forward to receiving your application.

_Why Monta

• Impact, not easy mode — your work matters, and you’ll feel it every day.

• Ownership from day one — we don’t micromanage, we expect you to deliver.

• The grind is real — priorities shift, and flexibility is sometimes needed to get things across the finish line. But so are the rewards: impact, growth, and a team that has your back.

• The people are extraordinary — talented, driven, and fun to work with. You’ll be challenged, supported, and inspired in equal measure

**What We Offer

**

• A yearly education budget and extra days off to use it.

• A friendly and social company culture with movie nights, Friday bars, pub crawls, and more.

• Free lunch every day.

• Pension & health coverage to keep you secure for today and tomorrow.

• Paid parental leave to support life’s big moments.

• Warrants program - be part of our growth story.

• Flexible working hours; as long as you’re at key meetings and delivering great work, we trust you to manage your schedule.

**Please send us your application in English.

**To succeed in this position, your spoken and written English skills need to be proficient. Since Monta is a globally active company, you’ll be communicating often and regularly with our co-workers and partners around the world, making your professional English knowledge essential.

Please note that we don’t accept unsolicited applications from headhunters or recruitment agencies. Unsolicited applications sent to our company or co-workers are considered to be the property of Monta, and we won’t agree to pay any referral compensation or recruiter fee without a signed agreement.

Find out more by visiting https://monta.com/uk/careers/

Monta is building the platform that powers the future of EV charging. We connect hardware, software, businesses, and drivers into one seamless ecosystem. Our mission is to make charging simple, reliable, and scalable for everyone.
